idea-plugin.name: EN 301 549 Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Flags the EN 301 549 clause each line breaks, and separates what is in force today from what arrives with V4.1.1.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → EN 301 549 Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 28 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/en301549-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/en301549-lint

action.description: Run EN 301 549 Lint on the file in the editor
